title: Morning Briefing: Tuesday 17 November 2026
excerpt: 11 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.
summary: 11 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.
content_html:
11 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • Friend backs Springhill Hospice Christmas appeal after Leanne Field’s last Minions party Rochdale
    Sally Kerr is backing Springhill Hospice’s Christmas appeal in memory of her best friend Leanne Field, 45, who had one last party at the Rochdale hospice two days before she died.
  • Rochdale Boroughwide Housing to demolish Seven Sisters tower blocks due to high refurbishment costs Rochdale
    Rochdale Boroughwide Housing has decided to demolish the Seven Sisters tower blocks due to high refurbishment costs, with plans for new homes to follow.
  • Kyle Howard pleads guilty to murder of wife Keeley Aspinall in Rochdale Rochdale
    Kyle Howard, 37, of Tweedale Street, Rochdale, admitted murdering his wife Keeley Aspinall, 44, at Manchester Crown Court and will be sentenced on Wednesday 18 November.
  • Join for a Toy membership launched to support Rochdale Christmas Toy Appeal Rochdale
    Your Trust Rochdale has launched a new membership initiative called Join for a Toy, aimed at supporting this year's Christmas Toy Appeal.
  • Seven Sisters to be demolished as RBH plans around 600 new homes at College Bank Rochdale
    All seven College Bank tower blocks will come down, with a planning application for around 600 new homes expected in early 2027. RBH expects every remaining customer to have moved out by summer 2027.
  • Why Rochdale says ‘cruckle’ Rochdale
    ‘Cruckle’ is the local verb for rolling or twisting an ankle — an old dialect survival that Rochdale speakers still recognise as a hometown word.
  • More than 60 properties in Heywood left without power due to cable incident Heywood
    A power cut affecting 65 properties in north Heywood was caused by an underground cable incident, with restoration efforts underway.
  • Students trained as Rochdale Creative Health Advocates at Falinge Park High School Falinge
    Students from various schools participated in training to become Creative Health Advocates, aimed at promoting health and wellbeing in the community.
  • Rochdale AFC youth team faces Bolton in U-17 PDL Cup Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC's youth team will compete against Bolton Wanderers in the U-17 PDL Cup on Tuesday, with kick-off scheduled for 2pm.
  • Plans for new Heywood fire station submitted to Rochdale Council Heywood
    Greater Manchester Fire and Rescue Service has proposed a new fire station in Heywood, set to replace the existing facility on Middleton Road.
  • Free illuminated festival to transform historic gardens in Rochdale Rochdale
    A free illuminated festival will take place in Rochdale's historic gardens this November, featuring a multi-sensory trail exploring the human body and various live performances.

Weather: Heavy rain 6°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
